About this Event

Feel the late-night energy of a good night out in Delhi - in Bellevue!
Saturday October 17th is your chance to experience ONE NIGHT IN DELHI right here in the US.
DJ Prashant brings the sound track of India's capital city to MIRRA for an immersive live video DJ set on the massive 50Ft LED screen.
Expect Punjabi, Bollywood, Desi club hits, and DJ Prashant remixes.

Not just a playlist; a full experience.
Prepare to be moved by 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗗𝗝 𝗣𝗥𝗔𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗡𝗧. An iconic performer and master of the crowd, Prashant is the best in the game when it comes to delivering an unforgettable night of music, pure energy, and core memories.
An ex-Intel engineer turned DJ, choreographer, singer, and event producer, Prashant doesn’t just play tracks—he curates moments. Known for his viral mashups and exclusive, genre-blending sets, he fuses signature edits with highly interactive dance energy.
With 𝟮𝟬𝗠+ 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗧𝘂𝗯𝗲 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀 and 𝟱𝟬𝗞+ 𝘀𝘂𝗯𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗯𝗲𝗿𝘀, his mission is simple: bring cultures together and keep you dancing longer than you ever thought possible.
